text: Issuing contingent capital securities with a conversion feature is a way for a banking entity to signal to its market that it will adhere to stricter standards, ethical or otherwise.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1998455

isBasedOn.name: Initial Reflections on the Possible Application of Contingent Capital in Corporate Governance

abstract: The issuance of contingent capital securities with a conver- sion feature could signal adherence to stricter standards.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where the market can observe and interpret the issuance as a commitment
the author notes the signaling effect of any particular issuance is difficult to ascertain
